verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and HR SaaS platform, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The help-center articles cover payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration UI, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
